## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped to Researk's local-first harness and CLI.
- [ ] I searched for related issues, discussions, and pull requests.
- [ ] I added or updated proportionate tests, or explained why tests are not applicable.
- [ ] I updated user-facing and architectural documentation when behavior changed.
- [ ] I considered security, privacy, untrusted input, credentials, and sensitive research data.
- [ ] I did not include secrets, private manuscripts, unpublished participant data, or proprietary datasets.
- [ ] I documented breaking changes and migration steps.
- [ ] My commits include a DCO `Signed-off-by` trailer (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] I have read and will follow the Code of Conduct and contribution guidance.
